Title: Public and project-scoped feeds for Azure Artifacts

Body.Content:
Azure Artifacts, which can be used to store and share reusable code packages for .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript, now allows teams to create public feeds, accessible by anyone on the Internet without authentication. Additionally, teams can also create Artifact feeds that are restricted to individual projects, while previously they were always open to the entire organization a project belonged to.
